context_distribution: Uniform random directions conditioned on |n_x| > 0.55; nested first M from 32 directions
classical_measurements: Twelve nonidentity first-spin Pauli strings, independent settings with equal allocation; unbiased U-statistics for squares, independent setting products for cross terms; all outcomes reused across queries
quantum_measurements: One two-copy exchange execution per query shot; total copies divided equally among M contexts
model_selection: For each dataset, compact and matched QNN optimizer start selected by validation MSE at 64 training states
uncertainty: Monte Carlo standard error across replicate full-state experiments; source-state uncertainty remains separate
scope: Inference only after exact-expectation training; fixed test states and new held-out-axis query pool
